access_contract.u64_read_basis: The pinned ARM64 memcpy_fromio implementation performs a 64-bit read for the naturally aligned 8-byte timestamp fields.

addressing.qmp_relationship: The APSS QMP page at 0x0c300000 is a separate owner and is not extended or repurposed by this leaf.

canonicalization.digest_covers: Every byte of this complete canonical JSON file, including its final LF.
canonicalization.digest_storage: A separate companion file; the companion file is not included in the contract digest.

evidence_binding.visibility: The retained research receipt and original firmware byte windows are private audit evidence, not a public download.

initialization.evidence: The identified AOP initialization path clears eight 32-bit words in each of three records at offsets 0, 32 and 64, then writes their three type tags. The directory initialization is called earlier in the same reachable initialization chain.
initialization.physical_runtime_distinction: The identified firmware contains separate runtime update functions. Zero initialized fields are not evidence that the real AOP has never slept.
initialization.reference_reset_behavior: Restore the same initialized reference snapshot when the profile is enabled; disabled profile continues rejecting accesses.

aop_image.provenance_class: Previously saved current active-slot image; not asserted to be an untouched factory release.

migration_identity.algorithm: SHA-256 of this complete canonical contract file including final LF
migration_identity.immutable_contents: The reference data retain exactly the initialized contract values across migration; no live or evolving statistics are carried by this profile.

profile.does_not_represent: AOP execution or the live statistics of the physical device.
profile.name: firmware-initialized-reference
profile.represents: The state immediately after the identified AOP record-initialization function completes, before any later runtime update.

public_sources.digest_scope: Each sha256 and git_blob_sha1 identifies the complete unmodified source file at the pinned commit.
public_sources.vendor_match_scope: The fixed public vendor sources match the observed ABI; they are not asserted to be the complete build provenance of the production kernel.

unsupported: Runtime sleep entry or exit events
Counter or timestamp updates from host time or guest time
Interrupts, timers, clocks or power transitions attributed to this leaf
DDR residency statistics and the separate 0x0c3f001c offset cell
Other global message-RAM directory entries or holes
Expansion or replacement of the APSS QMP page
